title: d17-features --kind option omits all 156 section-nested option fields, including the brief's owed weekend/holiday cell
claim: tools/audit/enumerate.py:d17 prints an option line only for keys in options.step.<step>.data, so the 156 of 286 options fields strings.json declares under sections.<section>.data (comfort, tuning, hot_water, building, entities and six more pages) are absent from D17's option universe, including all 8 weekend/holiday comfort fields D17.md step 3 names as an owed option line.
mechanism: d17() iterates body.get('data') per step and never descends into body['sections'][*]['data']; the options flow renders most fields inside section() groups since the page grouping, so every grouped field left the universe and no seat's coverage row can name it as not_reached.

evidence.unit: options fields declared in strings.json but not printed

perturbation.change: --perturb-sections: wrap enumerate.d17 to also emit each section's data keys

metric_definition: count of options.step.*.(data|sections.*.data) keys in strings.json with no 'option <step>.<key>' line from d17-features --kind option
phenomenon_property: Every field a user can set in the options (and config) flow is one line of the d17-features universe, whatever section it renders in.
seam_rule: python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D17/s1/h_enum.py (MISSING lines list every omitted field by page)

null_control.note: with sections walked the universe is 286 = declared, owed cell 8 of 8

reproduction_steps: python3 tools/audit/enumerate.py d17-features --kind option | grep -c weekend  # 0
proposed_fix_scope: tools/audit/enumerate.py d17(): also walk sections.*.data for config and options steps; its --self-test gains a planted sectioned field arm. Rotation/coverage of the next D17 round then includes the 156 fields.
